title: GoPro has been acquired and is getting into ‘defense, government, robotics and aerospace’
summary: GoPro suddenly looks like a very different company than it did just last week. First, YouTuber Mark "Markiplier" Fischbach became the company's single largest shareholder, without disclosing that in a sponsored review that came out a week later.
